quests.title: The Toll Road
text: A bandit village sits on the road, and a merchant is held at its gate for a toll he cannot pay. Clear out the bandits and their leader, then walk him to safety.

tasks.title: Drive off the bandits holding the merchant

encounter.name: Freed Merchant
lines: They let me go? You actually... Thank you! Take me to a proper village, please.

tasks.title: Walk the freed merchant to the nearest village

quests.title: The Bandits' Ledger
text: The bandits who hold these towers keep a ledger of every caravan they've robbed, torn into pages and hidden among their stores so no one man can sell them out. Fight off the archers and find the pages: the villages they robbed will want to know.

tasks.title: Fight off the archers on the walkways

item.name: Ledger Page
item.tooltip: A page of the bandits' accounts

search.found: Under the sacks you find a torn ledger page.

tasks.title: Find the three ledger pages in the bandits' stores

quests.title: The Great Cage
text: A giant aviary stands open on the mountainside with its keepers long gone. Birds are still caged inside, and they will starve.

tasks.title: Clear the nesters off the upper tiers
Free and befriend three caged birds

quests.title: Steam and Shadows
text: The bathhouse's pools still steam, and something lurks under the water. Someone drowned here, and the bath master's ledger says who and why.

tasks.title: Clear the drowned from the pools

quests.title: The Foundry's Last Blueprint
text: The foundry's furnaces have gone cold but its guardians still walk the floor, keeping the master smith's plans. Take the plans, and forge what they describe.

tasks.title: Forge the shield the plans describe

quests.title: The Siege of Keep Kayra
text: Keep Kayra's garrison went mad and still holds its walls. Fight up through the gatehouse to the lord of the keep, then hold his throne room against the last of his men.

tasks.title: Fight up through the gatehouse and towers

lines: His last men are coming. Hold the throne room!

tasks.title: Hold the throne room against his last wave

rewards.name: Kayra's Edge
lore: Taken from the mad lord's hand.

quests.title: The Clockwork Hive
text: The mechanical nest hums with things that aren't quite alive. Its guardians carry a mainspring: the heart of the hive. A Crafters' guild mason would very much like to study it.

lines: A mainspring? From the hive itself? Let me see.
Beautiful. Dreadful. Whoever made this had patience.
The guild will pay you for the loan, and I'll write up what it does.
tasks.title: Show the mainspring to a Crafters' guild mason

quests.title: Samples from the Asylum
text: The plague asylum's wards still hold the sick and what feeds on them. The Herbalists want samples from its apothecary, and a cure brewed from the notes.

tasks.checkmark: I brewed the cure from the apothecary's notes

quests.title: The Palace Treasury
text: Shiraz Palace kept a fire burning in every court, and the old scholars wrote that the treasury answers only to a palace whose fires are lit. Relight the dead court fires and search for the treasury's seal among the palace stores.

tasks.title: Relight three of the court fires

search.found: With the fires lit, you notice a brass seal glinting at the bottom of the chest.

quests.title: The Thornborn Ascent
text: Thorns have swallowed the Thornborn Towers from the roots up, and the vines fight back. Climb to the top and bring down a cutting of the first thorn.

tasks.title: Fight the thorns' guardians on the climb
Cut a piece of the first thorn from the summit

quests.title: Swarming Stones
text: Every wall of the infested temple hides silverfish. Reach the inner sanctum and smash its brood stones before the swarm closes the way out.

lines: The walls are moving. Break the brood stones!

tasks.title: Smash the brood stones before the swarm closes in

quests.title: The Old Order's Temple
text: An abandoned temple of the old order still keeps its sacred fire pit. The inscriptions name four offerings to be burned there before the reliquary will open.

tasks.title: Burn the offerings at the temple's fire

quests.title: The Spore Folk
text: A village built inside giant mushrooms trades in caps and spores. Their people will teach you to grow the mushrooms, if you bring back a full set of blocks.

encounter.name: Spore Elder
lines: Visitors from above! We trade caps and spores for kindness.
Grow them in the dark, damp and quiet. Never hurry a mushroom.

quests.title: Fire in the Hole
text: The scorched mines burn, and the last shift never came up. Find the trapped miners through the heat and get them out before the next collapse.

encounter.name: Trapped Miner

to.label: a village, out of the heat

lines: Here! Behind the rubble! The roof came down hours ago!

tasks.title: Lead the trapped miners out of the fire

quests.title: Empty Stands
text: The coliseum's stands are empty, but its gates still open for a challenger. A note pinned to the gate sends you to the Bounty Office, who know who runs the fights now.

lines: The coliseum? Still open? Hm.
A hunter named Dray ran the fights, until he stopped coming to the office.
Take a decree. If you fight there, fight for coin.
tasks.title: Ask the Bounty Office who runs the fights now

quests.title: Tea at the Witch Villa
text: The witches of the swamp villa are holding a tea party, and their recipe book lies open on the table. Copy it unseen, and brew their strangest potion yourself.

tasks.checkmark: I copied the witches' recipe book unseen

quests.title: The Old Manor
text: The old manor's doors lock behind you. The family who lived here hid four keys among the house's stores before they fled, and the last of them opens the study where their final letter waits.

item.name: Manor Key
item.tooltip: One of the family's four keys

search.found: Wrapped in an old cloth, a heavy iron key.

quests.title: The Temple on the Peak
text: An ancient temple sits on a mountain peak above the clouds. The shepherds below say that once, four fires burned at its corners and the whole valley could see it. Bring fire back to the peak.

tasks.title: Set four fires burning at the temple

quests.title: The Sacred Relic
text: The relic temple's altar is empty. Jungle thieves took the relic, and their trail leads to a nearby ruin.

tasks.title: Follow the thieves' trail to a ruin
Take the relic back from the thieves
Return the relic to its altar

quests.title: The Sword in the Hill
text: A giant warped sword is driven into the shattered hills, as if dropped from the Nether. The forger's mark on its hilt names who made it.

search.found: In the hilt's hollow lies a smith's token, stamped with a mark you don't know.

tasks.title: Climb to the hilt and find the forger's mark

quests.title: The Cathedral
text: A cathedral stands alone in the wilds, its bell tower cracked. Climb the tower and ring the bell; a cleric will arrive to say why the town around it never got built.

tasks.title: Climb the tower and ring the bell

encounter.name: Wandering Cleric
lines: I heard the bell! Nobody's rung it in years.
The town was never built because the builders found something under the foundations, and left in the night. Nobody will say what.

tasks.title: Meet the cleric who answers the bell

quests.title: Wrong Side of the Portal
text: Warped wood houses and towers stand in the Overworld where nothing warped should grow. The Arcane Order suspect a leak from the Nether, and want a sample.

tasks.title: Take a sample of the warped wood

lines: Warped planks, in the Overworld? That shouldn't be possible.
A leak from the Nether, then. The Order will look into it.
Well done. Keep away from the portal until we know more.
tasks.title: Show the sample to the Arcane Order

quests.title: A Beacon Gone Dark
text: A ruined beacon still has its pyramid, half-robbed by looters. Replace the missing blocks and light it again, so the beam can be seen from miles away.

tasks.title: Gather iron blocks to rebuild the pyramid

quests.title: Too Good to Be True
text: A desert ruin has a chest sitting out in the open, unguarded. The chest bites. Beat the mimic, and the real loot is under the sand where it sat.

tasks.title: Beat the mimic guarding the loot

quests.title: The Pharaoh's Vault
text: The desert temple's tomb is sealed, and its corridors are trapped. The builders left hidden switches for their own way in. Press them, mind the plates, and find what the pharaoh was buried with.

tasks.title: Find and press three hidden switches

item.name: Pharaoh's Ankh
item.tooltip: Gold, and warm to the touch

search.found: Among the grave goods lies a golden ankh, warm to the touch.

tasks.title: Find what the pharaoh was buried with

quests.title: Traps of the Jungle Temple
text: A jungle temple's halls are full of dart traps and crushing floors. A carving at the entrance gives a warning and a deadline: be at the treasure room before the floors close.

lines: The carving's warning echoes in your head: before the floors close.

tasks.title: Get inside before the floors close

search.found: Behind the treasure, a small jade idol.

quests.title: The Bridge Builder
text: On one of the old river bridges you find the builder's plaque: it asks that someone build one more. Cross another river with a bridge of your own.

tasks.title: Build a bridge across a river

quests.title: The Broken Gate
text: A ruined portal stands half-collapsed with crying obsidian in its frame. Rebuild the frame, but don't light it yet: the Arcane Order want a word first.

tasks.title: Gather obsidian to mend the frame

lines: You rebuilt a portal? Unlit, I hope.
Portals are doors, and doors can be opened from either side.
Leave it cold until we've looked at it. Please.
tasks.title: Tell the Arcane Order before you light it

quests.title: The Igloo's Basement
text: Under an igloo's carpet, a ladder leads to a cell holding a zombie villager. Cure him with weakness and a golden apple, and he will tell you whose igloo it was.

tasks.title: Cure the prisoner in the cell

quests.title: Stones That Remember
text: Activating a wild waystone starts something. The Couriers say there's a whole network of them, each one remembers the others.

tasks.title: Attune five waystones in the wild

quests.title: Frostbitten Ruins
text: Frozen spires and an abandoned village in the snow, built by no people anyone knows. Something very large sleeps far below. Note it, copy the writing, and leave it alone for now.

tasks.checkmark: I copied the ruins' writing and left whatever sleeps below

rewards.name: Page of the Old Ruins' Writing
lore: Copied in the snow, in a shaking hand.

quests.title: Occupied Dunes
text: A desert village has been occupied by scouts of something that digs, and a dig site nearby goes deeper than it should. Drive the scouts off, read the foreman's notes, and leave the pit alone.

tasks.title: Drive the scouts out of the village

quests.title: Back to the Ruins
text: Now the old ruins' writing makes sense: the snow ruins and the desert dig site point to the prisons of something buried. Revisit one of each and read the inscriptions that name it.

tasks.title: Return to the snow ruins to read the inscriptions
Return to the dig site to read its inscriptions

tasks.checkmark: I read the inscriptions that name what is buried here

rewards.name: Names of the Buried
lore: The inscriptions point toward the strongholds.

quests.title: The Ominous Woods
text: Entering the ominous woods at night, you hear something hunting through the trees. Survive until dawn without leaving the woods.

lines: Something is hunting you through the trees. Hold until dawn.

tasks.title: Survive the night in the ominous woods

quests.title: The Mountain That Smokes
text: You've found a volcano, smoking and black. The Miners' Guild would pay for lava, black sand and magma from its crater.

tasks.title: Scoop a bucket of lava from the crater
Take black sand from the slopes
Chip magma from the crater's rim

quests.title: The Lonely Cap
text: A single mushroom house stands far from anywhere with its door ajar and its owner missing. A trail of spores leads from the doorstep into the cave behind, where spiders have him cornered.

tasks.title: Drive the spiders off the trapped hermit

encounter.name: Mushroom Hermit
lines: Oh, thank the caps! They had me pinned for two days.
Take me home, please. The stew's gone cold.

quests.title: The Chapel in the Pines
text: An abandoned chapel still has its bell, but the rope has rotted and the candles have burnt out. Someone in the forest has been listening for it for years.

tasks.title: Bring a new rope for the bell

encounter.name: Chapel Keeper
lines: I heard the bell! After all these years!
I used to keep this chapel. The forest took the road, and I took the forest.
Thank you for ringing it. It sounds just as I remembered.

tasks.title: See who comes out of the forest

quests.title: The Outcasts
text: Villagers cast out of their village live in a shack on their own. They'd like to go home, if anyone would carry their apology.

encounter.name: Outcast Villager
lines: Cast out for a harvest dispute, can you believe? Over a cabbage.
We'd go home tomorrow if they'd have us. Would you take our apology?

tasks.title: Carry their apology to the nearest village

lines: They apologised? Over the cabbage?
Well. It was a very good cabbage. Tell them they're welcome home.
tasks.title: Deliver the apology to the village

quests.title: Northern Runes
text: Northern ruins carry runes on their standing stones. Three of them read together point to a buried chest.

search.found: A rubbing of the runes, tucked in the stonework.

tasks.title: Read the runes at three northern ruins

tasks.checkmark: I followed the runes to the buried chest

quests.title: The Engineer's Plans
text: The engineer left plans for a machine half-built: a working piston door. His notes list the parts.

search.found: Notes in a cramped hand, with a parts list.

tasks.title: Make the sticky pistons the notes call for

quests.title: The Mirage
text: The desert outpost keeps a water barrel and a logbook of travellers who never arrived. The next oasis is a hard walk across the dunes, and the barrel only holds so much.

lines: The barrel's nearly dry. Cross the dunes before your water runs out.

tasks.title: Cross the dunes before the water runs out

tasks.checkmark: I added my name to the logbook

quests.title: Gallows Hill
text: A notice on the gallows names a thief who swore he was innocent. The real culprit dropped a coin purse nearby, and the Village Watch could clear the dead man's name.

search.found: A coin purse, stitched with the wrong man's initials.

tasks.title: Search the gallows for the culprit's purse

lines: A purse stitched with the wrong initials? That changes things.
The man they hanged was framed. We'll have his name cleared.
Thank you for coming forward.
tasks.title: Clear the dead man's name with the Watch

quests.title: Grove of Remembrance
text: A monument to a felled forest stands on bare ground. Plant a sapling of every vanilla tree around it and bone-meal them up, and the grove will return.

tasks.title: Plant a sapling of every tree around the monument

quests.title: Nobody's Home
text: Lonely houses stand empty along the roads, tables still set. A diary, torn into pages, is scattered through them. Gather its pages to learn where the families went.

search.found: A page from a diary, with a date and a worried hand.

tasks.title: Search three empty houses for diary pages

quests.title: The Circle of Stones
text: A witch's circle of stones stands in the swamp. A potion is carved into its stones, and the old tales say a witch's familiar answers when it is poured at the centre.

tasks.title: Brew the potion carved into the stones
Pour the potion into the cauldron

encounter.name: Witch's Familiar
lines: Meow. The witch's tongue is in my mouth, and she says you may pass.

quests.title: Reading the Obelisks
text: Obelisks in the desert carry the same carvings in different orders. One symbol appears on every one, and the old tales say it points to a cache.

tasks.checkmark: I noted the carvings on the first obelisk
I noted the carvings on the second obelisk
I noted the carvings on the third obelisk, and the symbol they share

quests.title: Shards of the Trail
text: Trail ruins hide their past under suspicious gravel. Brush out four different pottery sherds and fit them on a decorated pot to read the story they tell.

tasks.title: Bring a brush for the suspicious gravel
Fit the sherds onto a decorated pot

quests.title: Fresh from the Oven
text: The village bakery's baker is behind on orders for the festival. Bake a strawberry cake, a baguette and a tray of cupcakes and deliver them.

encounter.name: Harried Baker
lines: You baked all of it? And on time? I could kiss you. I won't. Flour.
Take a rolling pin. I have three.

tasks.title: Deliver the baking before the festival

quests.title: Brewfest
text: A brewfest tent stands in the plains with a contest board. Brew three beers, enter them, and beat the brewfest regulars and the Beer Elemental they keep in the cellar.

tasks.title: Beat the Beer Elemental in the cellar

quests.title: Fondue at the Chalet
text: The alpine chalet's cook makes fondue for climbers, but the cheese cellar is empty. Bring cheese of three kinds from Meadow's animals and cook the fondue together.

quests.title: The Observation Post
text: An alpine observation post has a list of animals to sight pinned to its sill. Photograph three of them for the survey.

quests.title: The Gardener's Cottage
text: A cottage in the woods with a garden gone wild. The wandering gardener who lives there wants her beds replanted, and will give a cutting of each.

encounter.name: Wandering Gardener
lines: Oh, a visitor! My garden's got away from me, I'm afraid.
Could you replant the beds? Anemones, bluebells, amaryllis. I'll give you cuttings.

quests.title: The Gingerbread House
text: A gingerbread house in the snow, and a gingerbread golem that won't let anyone eat the walls. Bake it some gingerbread cookies and eggnog to win it over.

tasks.title: Bake gingerbread cookies for the golem

lines: Crumble crumble. You brought cookies? And a drink?
My house, my walls. But you may have one gumdrop.
Merry Midwinter.
tasks.title: Win over the gingerbread golem

quests.title: The Butterfly Lovers
text: A lonely grave where two butterflies always circle. The legend carved on it asks for two matching butterflies to be set free at the grave.

tasks.title: Read the legend on the grave
Catch a matching pair of butterflies

tasks.checkmark: I released the pair at the grave

quests.title: Bring Them Home
text: A skeleton in armour lies where an adventurer fell. Take the name tag and gear found on it to the nearest village and tell the family, who will want to know.

tasks.title: Carry the news to the nearest village

lines: A name tag? Let me see. Oh, no. Not young Brin.
The family will want to know. We'll tell them gently.
They'll want you to have his sword, I think.
tasks.title: Tell the family through the Village Watch

rewards.name: The Fallen Adventurer's Blade
lore: Returned by the one who brought them home.

quests.title: Petals on the Wind
text: A cherry grove in bloom, pink petals drifting through the air. The Herbalists would love a sample of its petals, its saplings and its bees' honey.

tasks.title: Take honey from the grove's bees

quests.title: Mooshroom Shores
text: You've landed on a mushroom island. A mushroom idol stands on some of them, and the mooshrooms give stew instead of milk.

tasks.title: Milk a mooshroom for a bowl of stew

quests.title: Lavender Haze
text: A field of lavender hums with bees. The Herbalists say a calming tea from it settles the nerves of the whole village.

quests.title: Where It All Began
text: You've stumbled into the rare Origin Valley, where the world looks as it did long ago. The Field Guide would love a block of its old grass and a rose.

tasks.title: Take a block of the old grass

quests.title: Alpha Grove
text: The alpha grove is all old-style leaves and grass, like a memory of the world before. Bring back its saplings and leaves before you forget what it looked like.

quests.title: The Mystic Grove
text: A mystic grove glows with strange flowers. A fairy shows itself among them if you wait quietly, and will lead you to its ring.

encounter.name: Grove Fairy
lines: Ssh. You waited. Nobody waits.
Follow me, if you like. There's a ring of mushrooms. It is very nice.

tasks.title: Wait quietly for the fairy to appear

quests.title: Giants of the Forest
text: A redwood forest, with trees taller than any tower. The Crafters' guild wants wood from one of the giants, and a climb to the top is the only way to reach the good branches.

tasks.title: Bring down redwood logs from the giants

quests.title: Hot Springs
text: Hot springs steam in the cold air. Soak in the thermal water until you're fully healed, and take a bottle home for a sore friend.

tasks.title: Bottle the spring water for a sore friend

quests.title: Snowblossom
text: A snowblossom grove, white petals in the snow. The Herbalists want leaves and a sapling to see if it will grow in the village.

quests.title: The Wasteland
text: A dried-out wasteland, nothing living in it. A single dead tree stands at its heart, and the Couriers want to know if the way across is safe.

tasks.title: Bring wood from the dead tree at its heart

quests.title: The Pumpkin Patch
text: A pumpkin patch stretches to the horizon. The Growers' co-op would love your biggest pumpkins, and the children want a jack o'lantern.

quests.title: Under the Baobabs
text: Baobabs rise from the savanna like upside-down trees. The Crafters' guild would love some of their wood, and the herds that pass beneath are worth a look.

quests.title: White Cliffs
text: White chalk cliffs rise above the sea. Climb from the beach to the top without a fall, and bring chalk for the Crafters' guild.

tasks.title: Climb the cliffs and bring back chalk

quests.title: Among the Spires
text: Stone spires jut from the land like needles. Stand on top of the tallest you can find and look across the world.

tasks.checkmark: I stood on the tallest spire

quests.title: Magnolia in Bloom
text: A magnolia woodland in bloom, with a shining meadow beyond it. The Herbalists want its flowers and the meadow's glistening grass.

quests.title: Ashen Woods
text: An ashen woodland, burnt long ago. Bring back some ash and a surviving sapling to see if the soil can heal.

quests.title: Land of Cacti
text: A desert of towering saguaro cacti. The Growers' co-op would like a cutting of each cactus and a joshua tree sapling, if you don't hug the cactus.

quests.title: Above the Clouds
text: The mountains here climb far higher than they should. Stand above the clouds on foot and look down at the world.

quests.title: The Deep Valley
text: Rivers here cut deep valleys. Follow one down to where it meets the sea and fish at its mouth, where the Anglers say the biggest fish gather.

tasks.title: Follow the river to the sea

quests.title: Ice Spikes
text: Spikes of ice rise from a frozen plain. The Miners' Guild want packed ice from the top of a spike, which only a pick with silk touch will take.

tasks.title: Mine packed ice from the top of a spike

quests.title: The Painted Badlands
text: The badlands are banded in every colour of clay. The Crafters' guild want a sample of each colour from the canyon walls.

quests.title: The Grand Tour
text: The Couriers keep a list of the biomes of the Overworld, and offer a prize for anyone who has visited twenty. Nature's Compass helps you find the ones you're missing.

quests.title: A Song from Somewhere
text: You've found an old music disc, and a tune is waiting in it. Build a jukebox to hear it, then learn it on an instrument.

tasks.title: Make an instrument to learn the tune on

quests.title: Antique Ink
text: A bottle of antique ink from a chest. Ink a map with it and the map should show an old landmark that isn't on newer maps.

tasks.checkmark: I inked the map and followed it to the old landmark

quests.title: The Strange Key
text: A lone key from a dungeon chest, with a tag that names a safe. Find the safe in a ruin nearby, and open it.

tasks.title: Find a ruin that might hold the safe
Open the safe with the strange key

quests.title: An Ancient Egg
text: A sniffer egg, warm to the touch. Hatch it on moss, raise the sniffer, and plant the first ancient seed it digs up.

tasks.title: Watch the sniffer hatch and grow
Take the first ancient seed it digs up
